about.title: About Us
about.story_title: Born from a Passion for Hookah
about.story_text_1: Tactical HB began with a simple desire — to elevate the hookah smoking experience to a new level. Our founder, a passionate shisha enthusiast, realised that the accessories available on the market often lacked the quality and uniqueness he was looking for.
about.story_text_2: Drawing inspiration from the striking materials and colours of weaponry, he set out to design, manufacture, and rigorously test products that not only looked special but delivered an unmatched smoking experience.
about.story_text_3: We take immense pride in being a Ukrainian brand. Our products reflect the craftsmanship and dedication that our country is known for.
about.value_1_text: Every product is made in Ukraine from the highest quality materials.
about.value_2_text: Weaponry-inspired aesthetics — unique in the hookah industry worldwide.
about.value_3_text: Aviation aluminium and specialist surface treatment, held to the same spec on every piece.
about.value_4_text: 33 active wholesale partners across Europe, the Middle East and the USA.
about.payment_text_1: We accept card payments — Visa and Mastercard — through Plata by Mono (Monobank), and international cards are accepted where available. Every transaction is handled by a certified payment gateway — your card details travel encrypted and are never stored on our servers.
about.payment_text_2: Checkout takes a few taps and needs no account. You'll receive confirmation by email the moment your payment succeeds, and we begin preparing your order the same working day.
about.payment_note: Prices are shown in hryvnia (₴) for orders within Ukraine and in euro (€) elsewhere.
about.delivery_text_1: Within Ukraine we ship with Nova Poshta and Ukrposhta — to a branch, a parcel locker, or by courier to your door. Delivery is calculated at checkout and included in your order total, so there is nothing to pay on collection.
about.delivery_text_2: International orders work the same way: delivery to your country is calculated at checkout and included in the order total, so you pay once, on the site. If a destination can't be quoted automatically, we confirm the full total by email first — still one payment, still one total.
about.returns_title: Fourteen days to change your mind
about.returns_intro: If something isn't right, we'll make it right. Any order can be returned within 14 days of receipt where the reason is justified — no excluded categories.
about.return_1_text: Return any order within 14 days of the date you received it, giving the reason for the return.
about.return_2_text: The item should be unused and returned complete, in the packaging it arrived in.
about.return_3_text: We keep no list of non-returnable products — everything we sell can be returned.
about.return_4_text: The cost of sending the item back to us is covered by the customer.
about.return_5_text: Email admin@tactical-hb.com with your order number and we'll send return instructions the same day.
about.returns_refund: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 days of us receiving and inspecting the returned item.
about.file_body: The standard behind the mark — the bay, the bench, and the case, in three short beats.

delivery.title: Payment & Delivery
delivery.intro: One order, one total. Everything you need to know about paying for and receiving your Tactical HB order.
delivery.payment_1: We accept secure online card payments (including international cards where available).
delivery.payment_2: You pay the full order total at checkout. That total is the price of your goods for the selected delivery destination.
delivery.delivery_1: Orders are shipped with established postal and courier partners — such as Nova Poshta in Ukraine, and international postal services where available.
delivery.delivery_2: Delivery cost depends on destination, weight and service type. At checkout we calculate the applicable amount and include it in your order total.
delivery.delivery_3: You are not charged a separate “delivery service” fee on a second invoice — you pay one total for your order.
delivery.ua_1: Branch, parcel locker (poshtomat) and courier options may be available depending on the carrier.
delivery.ua_2: Delivery is arranged after payment is confirmed.
delivery.intl_1: International shipping is available to selected countries.
delivery.intl_2: Shipping is calculated before payment and included in the order total.
delivery.intl_3: After payment, we dispatch the parcel through the relevant postal service. Customs rules of the destination country apply to the recipient where required.
delivery.after_2: We prepare and hand the parcel to the carrier.
delivery.after_3: You receive tracking when the shipment is on its way.
delivery.returns_1: Please see our Returns policy. Return shipping terms depend on the reason for return and the destination.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Tactical HB collects through tactical-hb.com, why we hold it, how long we keep it, and what you can ask us to do with it.
privacy.controller_1: Your data is held by Tactical HB, a private entrepreneur registered in Ukraine, operating from Kharkiv. Tactical HB decides what is collected and why, and is the data controller for everything described here.
privacy.controller_2: For any question about this policy, or to exercise any of the rights below, write to
privacy.collect_intro: We collect only what a specific part of the site needs in order to work. Nothing here is gathered speculatively.
privacy.collect_order: When you place an order: your name and surname, email address, phone number, and the delivery address or Nova Poshta branch you choose, together with what you ordered and what you paid. We need this to fulfil the order — it is processed to perform our contract with you.
privacy.collect_account: If you create an account: your email address, a password we never see in readable form, your name, and your marketing preference. Your favourites, loyalty points and vouchers are linked to that account.
privacy.collect_newsletter: If you subscribe to the newsletter: your email address, the language you want to be written to in, and the record of your consent. This is processed on the basis of that consent, and you can withdraw it at any time.
privacy.collect_cart: If you leave items in your basket and have opted in to our emails: your email address and the contents of that basket, so we can remind you. This is processed on the basis of your consent and stops the moment you unsubscribe or complete the order.
privacy.collect_forms: When you use the contact or wholesale form: the details you enter in it — typically a name, an email address, and your message or company details.
privacy.collect_cookies: Cookies and similar storage, as described below.
privacy.cookies_1: Necessary cookies are always on, because the site cannot work without them: they keep you signed in, remember your basket, and record the cookie choice you made so we do not ask again.
privacy.cookies_2: Analytics and marketing cookies are off until you switch them on. Nothing in either category is set before you accept it, and you can change your mind at any time through the cookie settings link in the footer.
privacy.sharing_intro: We do not sell your data and we do not share it for anyone else's marketing. It reaches a small number of providers only because they perform a part of the service:
privacy.sharing_hosting: Supabase and Vercel — hosting the database and the site itself.
privacy.sharing_payment: Monobank (Plata by Mono) — taking card payments. Your card details go directly to them; they never reach our servers.
privacy.sharing_delivery: Nova Poshta and Ukrposhta — delivering your order, which requires your name, phone number and delivery point.
privacy.sharing_email: Resend — sending order confirmations, shipping updates and, if you asked for them, our newsletters.
privacy.sharing_fiscal: Our fiscal receipt provider, where Ukrainian law requires a receipt to be issued for a sale.
privacy.sharing_legal: We will also disclose data where we are legally required to, and no further than that requirement goes.
privacy.retention_order: Order records are kept for as long as accounting and tax law in Ukraine requires us to keep them. We cannot delete these on request while that period is running.
privacy.retention_account: Account data is kept while your account exists. Delete the account and it goes with it.
privacy.retention_newsletter: Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe, after which we keep only the fact that you unsubscribed — so that we do not email you again by accident.
privacy.retention_cart: Abandoned basket records are cleared once the basket is bought or the reminder sequence ends.
privacy.rights_intro: Wherever the law gives you these rights — and under the GDPR, if you are in the EU, it does — you can ask us to:
privacy.rights_access: give you a copy of the data we hold about you;
privacy.rights_rectify: correct it, if it is wrong;
privacy.rights_erase: delete it, subject to the retention periods above;
privacy.rights_restrict: stop or limit what we do with it;
privacy.rights_portability: send it to you, or to someone else, in a portable format;
privacy.rights_object: stop processing it where we rely on your consent or on a legitimate interest.
privacy.rights_withdraw: Withdrawing consent is always free and always immediate: every marketing email carries an unsubscribe link, and the cookie settings can be reopened from the footer at any time. Withdrawing it does not undo anything we did lawfully beforehand.
privacy.rights_complain: If you think we have handled your data badly, please tell us first — but you are also entitled to complain to your national data protection authority, or in Ukraine to the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights.
privacy.transfers_1: We operate from Ukraine and our providers operate internationally, so your data may be processed outside your own country — including outside the European Economic Area. Where that happens we rely on our providers' own safeguards for those transfers.
privacy.security_1: Access to customer data is restricted to the people who need it to run the business. Passwords are stored only as irreversible hashes, card details never touch our systems, and traffic to the site is encrypted in transit.
privacy.security_2: No system is perfectly secure, and we will not pretend otherwise. If a breach ever affects your data and puts you at risk, we will tell you.
privacy.children_1: This site sells hookah accessories and is not intended for children. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under the age at which these products may lawfully be bought where they live.
privacy.changes_1: If this policy changes materially, we will update the date at the top of the page. If the change affects how we use data you have already given us, we will tell you directly rather than relying on you re-reading this page.
